# C — profit-optimal approval policy (generated by src/phase2/policy_C.py)

MILP over 30 cells (M2-PD decile on 2014 × amount band), maximise expected NPV on validation 2014 subject to approval ≥ 75% and expected bad rate (mean M2 PD) ≤ 11%. Expected NPV from A hazards, LGD 88.8%, discount 5% p.a. Evaluation on OOT 2015 uses realised cash: total_pymnt (incl. recoveries) − collection fee − funded (undiscounted) = the pre-registered metric. The last column ('EXPLORATORY realised NPV') is NOT pre-registered: realised cash discounted at the same rate with approximate timing (payments spread evenly to last payment month; recoveries 6 months later).
